site.name: Orbital Economy Terminal
site.description: The Orbital Economy Intelligence terminal: one resolved record per physical satellite, stitched from SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track decay messages, in a read-only public catalog with identifier crosswalks, operator attribution, cross-source conflicts, bus benchmarks, reachability and pending FCC filings.

routes.title: Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: See what is happening in orbit: the launches and reentries of the last 30 days, a year of launch tempo, who owns the active fleet, the constellation race and the space weather, all read from one resolved record per satellite that is stitched from SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track decay messages.

routes.title: Resolver · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Search the resolved satellite catalog and read one object's full identity: every source's identifier crosswalk, its ownership over time, and where SATCAT, GCAT and Space-Track disagree.

routes.title: Conflicts · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: This page lists three kinds of disagreement that the resolver had to adjudicate: status, reentry date and stale post-merger owner. They come from the data-quality report, and each row links into the resolver so that the underlying claims can be read.

routes.title: Operators · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: A league table of satellite operators over the resolved ownership graph, with each operator's hierarchy, fleet mix by status and orbital regime, and acquisition history.

routes.title: Review · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: Hard identity cases the graph resolved under conflicting sources, in an arbitration workbench where a recorded verdict turns coverage into per-failure-mode accuracy.

routes.title: Bus benchmarks · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: This page benchmarks spacecraft buses per manufacturer and per bus model. Fleet size, lifetime and disposal come from the catalogs and Space-Track decay messages, while time to operational and station-keeping come from GP element history, and every number is traceable to its source rows under a published methodology.

routes.title: Reachability · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: This page lists nearly every active satellite above your horizon right now, which it computes for a spot on Earth from public GP element sets no more than 14 days old, and it adds the transmitters that SatNOGS records for each one and its next passes.

routes.title: Filings · Orbital Economy Terminal
routes.description: This page lists pending FCC space-station applications from IBFS bulk data and harvested ICFS documents. A new application can describe satellites that are not in any tracking catalog yet, and a modification or temporary authority can concern a satellite that is already in orbit.
